articles.title: AI stocks keep dropping, while oil prices keep climbing
articles.description: More sell-offs for chip stocks and other AI winners are yanking markets lower. The S&P 500 fell 0.8% Friday and was on track to close out just its third losing week in the last 16. The Dow Jones Industrial Average dipped 40 points, and the Nasdaq composite sank 1.7%. Applied Materials and other companies in the chip industry helped lead the market lower, while Nvidia was the heaviest weight on the S&P 500. Netflix tumbled to one of the largest losses in the index after forecasting growth that fell short of analysts' expectations. Brent crude rose 3.1% on worries about the war with Iran.

articles.title: Magnetic octupole model captures domain-wall motion in noncollinear antiferromagnets
articles.description: Researchers from The Grainger College of Engineering at the University of Illinois Urbana-Champaign have developed the first magnetic multipole-based micromagnetic model for antiferromagnets. Published in Applied Physics Reviews, their generalized framework provides a theoretical and computational foundation for designing future spintronic devices made with antiferromagnetic materials.
